tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// tshe dpag med lha mang gi cho ga 'don 'grigs su bkod pa 'chi med 'dod pa'i re skong zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// 'chi med 'dod pa'i snying kha tsū ta'i phreng*// gsol 'debs me tog ci dgar rgod byas mthar// dngos grub mchog gi 'bras bus dud byed pa// tshe dpag med pa'i dus bzang gtan gyi skyabs// gang gi go 'phang nyid du 'gro 'dod na// grub pa'i rgyal mo'i gsung ngag rin chen skas// rje btsun ras pas gangs can 'dir btsugs pa// nor med 'di 'o shes ldan 'dzeg tu spyon/ 'dir ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs rje btsun ras chung pa'i gdams ngag tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par bsgom par 'dod pas/ 'di nyid kyi dbang thob cing dam tshig legs par bskyang pas/ dge ba'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la rnal 'byor gyi yo byad tshogs par byas la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas brtsams te mgon med bdag /byang chub snying po ma thob bar// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// bdag dang 'gro rnams skyabs pa'i phyir// rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi// tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs// phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa// mgon po khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags// slan chad sdig las zlog par bgyi// deng nas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi// khyed kyis bslab byar rjes su slob// khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da'o// kun nas yongs su bskyab tu gsol//

sems bskyed ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma sgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ tshe dpag med pa bcu drug zla ba'i cha// grub rgyal 'od dkar 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i dpyid// ras chung bdud rtsir 'dzag pa'i bka' drin gyis// kun la 'chi med sbyin der gsol ba 'debs// lha rdzas du ku la yi ras chen la// bsod nams rin chen mngon par bkod mdzad pa// bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i bka' drin gyis// kun la 'dod dgur sbyin der gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma rdo rje rin chen ze'u 'bru'i rtser// rgya ras byin rlabs sbrang rtsi rgyas gyur pa// chos rje khu dbon bung ba'i bka' drin gyis// kun la bcud len rtsal der gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang chos rje grub pa'i rin chen rtsis// ngag dbang 'jam pa'i rdo rjes gser bsgyur ba// pad+ma dkar po'i sbyin shugs bka' drin gyis// kun la nyer 'tshor gyur der gsol ba 'debs// ngag gi dbang phyug brnyes de 'chi med kyi// bdud rtsi'i rgyun mchog bzang po mtshor 'khyil ba// ngom par 'thung ste ris med gdul bya'i tshogs// kun la ci dgar sbyin der gsol ba 'debs// dpag bsam dbang po thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las// mi pham blo gros chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs te// kun dga' lhun grub chos kyi char 'bab pa// kun la bde 'byor sbyin der gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi dbang phyug yon tan mtsho rgyas klong*// chos rgyal dpal bzang thugs rje'i nor 'dzin brtan// kun dga' bstan 'dzin phrin las me tog rgyas// kun la bde legs sbyin der gsol ba 'debs// chos rgyal rgya mtsho yon tan mtha' bral gzhir// mos pa'i klu dbang dge legs rin chen gyi// gtsug tu mdzes pa rtsa ba'i bla ma yis// kun la mchog sbyin rtsol der gsol ba 'debs// rtsa yi mdud bshig srog gi lam 'gags nas// 'dzag med dga' ba'i pha mthar phyin pa yis// 'gro ba kun gyi mgon po nam mkha'i khams// ji srid 'tsho zhing gzhes par gyur cig gu/

dbang bzhi len pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ sgyu 'phrul zhing khams rgya mtsho rdul re'i sku// rdul snyed sangs rgyas rol mo la chas pa'i// glang chen dbang po pad+ma'i 'dab brgya'i mig /mchog gi sprul skur 'khrungs der gsol ba 'debs// bzo sbyangs lus zhugs sad pa'i dri bkrus nas// sna tshogs gzungs mar rtse ba'i dga' ston mthar// sku yi rdo rje rgyal srid chen po la// bum pa'i dbang bskur mdzad par byin gyis rlobs// las khyim thams cad dhu tir rang byung ba// rgyud mang gzhom med sgra der sbyar dka' ba'i// dbyangs la rab dga'i srid bral de'i snying por// nyin mor byed pa chas la gsol ba 'debs// lus kyi shing drung dag byed ku sha'i rtser// rmi lam bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo kha btags nas// mchog dga'i bsam gtan ma chags sangs rgyas su// gsang ba'i dbang bskur mdzad par byin gyis rlobs// gang ba'i zla 'od gsal ldan me tog ru// mngon par rol pas gnyis skyes lang tsho'i sde// 'ja' 'od 'khor lo bskor bas dag pa'i mdangs// ye shes lus su grags la gsol ba 'debs// yid sa rā dza gṛ haṃ rab byon nas// dman sar gnyid log ma lus dbugs phyung ste// khyad par dga' ba'i thig le'i go 'phang du// sher phyin dbang bskur mdzad par byin gyis rlobs// thabs kyi dkar dang shes rab nag po'i phyogs// rab dgongs dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor du// gsang ba chen po'i 'khor lo legs bsgyur ba'i// chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs der gsol ba 'debs// ye shes ku sha'i grong gi sa la'i tshal// bzhi pa'i lhag bcas gnas skabs rab phral nas// gnyis med mya ngan 'das pa rab ston pa'i// tshig gi dbang bskur mdzad par byin gyis rlobs// tshogs zhing spyan 'dren sogs ni/ rang gi snying gar hrīḥdamar po de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis bla ma rigs bdag gi rnam par bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dang*// tshe dpag med mgon gtsor bzhugs pa'i// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus par// rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal lo// bdag lus rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// dngos po kun gyis mchod par bgyi// sdig pa ma lus bshags lags shing*// bsod nams kun la yid dga' bas// chos kyi rnga chen brdung bskul te// nam mkha' ji srid bzhugs par gsol// yon gnas dam pa khyed mthus bdag /'chi med grub nas tshe 'di gar// sangs rgyas kun gyi drung phyin nas// dam chos ma lus 'dzin par shog/ lan gsum/ tshogs zhing rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang thob par bya de'i ched du rnal 'byor gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam pas/ snying ga'i hrīḥlas ye shes kyi me 'bar rnam smin gyi lus bsregs nas stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ sngar gyi hrīḥyongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rtsa ba'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa ljags 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ sma ra ser po/ steng du rta zhal ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug tho 'phyar bas bgegs dang 'byung po ma lus pa 'joms shing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub mdzad pa'i rtser me 'bar bas gnod byed ma lus pa bsreg pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i cod paṇa dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa brgya'i phyed kyi do shal dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ glang po che'i ko ba dang*/ mi yi pags pas stod g.yogs pa/ stag lpags rlon pas smad dkris pa/ cis kyang mi tshugs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin gshin rje'i gzugs lta bu'i sku las bskal pa'i me'i phung po steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du dmar 'ur 'ur 'phro ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bdud bzhi brdzis te pad+ma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ srid pa gsum zil gyis gnon pa nam mkha'i khams khyab pa zhig tu gyur/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i dbus su hrīḥ de las pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bgegs bar du gcod pa'i gdon 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde dpung thams cad snying gar lcags kyus btab/ zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdoms/ dril bus mnyes te brgyal zhing 'bog pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bsad gtub mes bsreg pa'i thal ba tsam du yang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces drug cu bzlas so// bsrung 'khor bsgom pa'o// de nas/ hrīḥgadan dang bcas pa e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ bh+rūṃ steng nas steng du rim pa bzhin brtsegs par gyur pa rnams zhu ba las/ chos 'byung gru gsum de'i nang du rlung*/ me/ chu/ sa'i dkyil 'khor lhun po'i steng du/ phyi me ri dang rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba'i nang sna tshogs pad+ma la rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i lte ba la gzhal yas khang rin po che sngo ser dkar ljang dmar ba'i rtsigs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i khyam shar sngo lho ser nub dkar byang ljang dbus dang lha snam dmar po/

lte bar āḥlas zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du pad+ma hrīḥdang paṃ gyi mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi tshe'i bar chad bsal/ thar pa la bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byas te/ de dag gi byin rlabs bsdus te hrīḥl thim nas zhu ba'i thig le las/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa li khri'i khu ba lta bur dmar ba/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi ba med pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa bsnams te yum la 'khyud pa/ shin tu zhi zhing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pas lta ba'i mig ngom pa med pa'i sku/ zur phud kyi rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang dar gyi na bzas legs par brgyan pas 'od zer gyi snang ba mtha' yas pa 'gyed cing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis zla nyi la bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul dang*/ zhabs pad+ma'i gdan gyi sked pa nas 'khril ba/ mtshar sdug yid kyis bris pa lta bur mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho la gnas pa'o// shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod tshe dpag med sngon po mnyam bzhag gi steng na baiḍūr+ya'i tshe bum bsnams pa/ lhor rin po che trāṃ gyis mtshan pa las rin 'byung tshe dpag med ser po mnyam bzhag gi steng na gser gyi tshe bum bsnams pa/ nub tu 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang tshe dpag med dkar po mnyam bzhag gi steng na shel gyi tshe bum bsnams pa/ byang du ral gri āḥyis mtshan pa las don grub tshe dpag med ljang kha mnyam bzhag gi steng na in+d+ra ni la'i tshe bum bsnams pa/ shin tu zhi zhing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pas lta ba'i mig ngom pa med pa'i sku/

zur phud kyi rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang dar zab kyis legs par brgyan pa/ 'od zer gyi snang ba mtha' yas pa 'gyed cing*/ rdo rje skyil krung gis zla nyi la bzhugs pa/ shar lhor māṃ las mā ma ki sngo ba g.yas rdo rje/ lho nub tu trāṃ las sgrol ma gser mdog g.yas rin po che/ nub byang du lāṃ las sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ byang shar du tāṃ las dam tshig sgrol ma ljang sngon g.yas ral gri/ thams cad kyis g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa mtshar sdug yid kyis bris pa lta bu mdzes pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho la gnas pa'o// shar gyi snam bur hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' bzhi mthing kha g.yas rdo rje/ lhor trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ las rin chen sems dpa' bzhi ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub tu oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ las rnam snang sems dpa' bzhi dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ byang du ā ā ā ā las las kyi sems dpa' bzhi ljang kha g.yas ral gri/ thams cad kyis g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha yi dbang phyug lta bur mdzes shing rgyan thams cad dang dar zab kyis lhab lhub tu spras pa'o// phyi'i gra bzhi'i mer mām̐ las bdug spos ma sngo bsangs/ bden bral du trāṃ las mar me ma gur gum gyi mdog rlung du lām̐ las me tog ma dkar mo/ dbang ldan du tām̐ las dri chab ma dmar skya/ shar sgor dzaḥlas lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor hūm̐ las zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor bam̐ las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor hoḥlas dril bu ma ljang khu/ brgyad po phyag g.yas rang ming gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ lha yi na chung mtshar mo rgyan dang gos kyi mdzes pa 'khril ldem gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'o// lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas nas bsgom pa ji lta ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par mos te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// gdod nas dag pa thugs rje'i gzugs// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon lta'i// gsung gi dbang phyug tshe dpag med// rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas// ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'gro ba'i don la spyan 'dren na// tshe zad tshe nyams gso ba'i phyir// myur ba nyid du gshegs su gsol// rdo rje rin chen rnam snang dang*// las kyi rigs mchog tshe dpag med// yum bzhi sems dpa' bcu drug dang*// mchod pa'i lha mo sgo mar bcas// tshe dang ye shes rgyas pa dang*// mchog gi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag gi dad pas spyan 'dren na// byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod par mdzad pas dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag po sprul pa'i sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/

de nas grwa bzhi'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsgom te/ ston zla ltar dkar rdo rje me tog ma// lha rdzas me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs byed// rdo rje'i rigs ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// tshe dpag med pa rdo rje'i yid dgyes mdzod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngo skya dud sprin rdo rje bdug spos ma// mkha' khyab dri zhim bdug pa'i spos sprin can/ rdo rje= tshe dpag= dhū pe= gur gum gzhon nu'i lus can snang gsal ma// rin chen snang bas phyogs bcu'i mun sel byed/ rdo rje= tshe dpag= ā lo ke= 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar skya byug pa ma/ legs sbyar dri mchog dge bas rnyog pa sel/ rdo rje= tshe dpag= gan+dhe= 'dod pa'i snam bu la gnas pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos la/ kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar gzugs can ma// rnam dag rin chen dngul dkar me long g.yob/ rdo rje= tshe dpag= rū pa= btso ma'i gser mdog rdo rje glu dbyangs ma// shes rab dbyangs snyan rna ba'i bcud len mkhan/ rdo rje= tshe dpag= girti= leb brgan rtsi ltar lus dmar ro ldan ma// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas 'dzin/ rdo rje= tshe dpag= rā s+ya= dūr ba'i 'dab ltar ljang ser reg bya ma// reg pa'i bde ba mchog ster na bza' 'dzin/ rdo rje= tshe dpag= spar+she= kun+dha ku muta rgyas 'dra chos dbyings ma// rgyal ba kun bskyed skye gnas phyag rgya can/ rdo rje= tshe dpag= dharma dhā tu= phyi mchod/ bdud rtsi'i snod lag pa g.yas pa'i snyim pa bkab/ oṃ ma dag pa sbyangs/ g.yon pa bkab/ āḥmang po spel/ gnyis ka bkab/ hūm̐ bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga'i rang bzhin du spar/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcings/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes brjod nas myang*/ nang mchod do// yum dang rjes su chags pa mdzad pas bde stong chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam pa ni gsang mchod do// bstod pa ni/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces pa'i mthar/ hrīḥ 'gro la rjes su chags pas dmar ba'i sku// 'char nub kyis 'phong snang ba mtha' yas pa// 'chi bdag bdud kyi mun las phyogs dus kun// rnam par rgyal mdzad tshe dpag med la 'dud// bcu drug yid 'ong lang tsho'i gang ba la// mtshan dpe'i ro mo mtshar po kun bris pas// 'dren byed thams cad bdud rtsi'i tshim pa bzhin// snying gi dga' ba chu gter spel la 'dud// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya kha yi bum bzang nas// tshe dang bsod nams ye shes bskyed pa'i chus// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar// kun mkhyen sa la dbang bskur de la 'dud// bsam gtan pa yi yid ngos 'ja' tshon mdangs// rin chen rgyan dang na bza' chags pa'i dbyibs// bi shwa'i ngal ba zong du bsgyur bas kyang*// lha dbang tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon la 'dud// skyil krung pang na dga' mgu'i rtsed 'jo ma// bde sogs 'chi med bu mo'i 'dod yon las// cir yang 'phags pa'i srid zhu'i rtag dgyes pa// 'dod chags chen po'i 'phrul der phyag 'tshal lo// du ma'i blo ngor rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyod// rigs bzhi'i dbang phyug nyid nas grangs med par// song ba ji bzhin rgyal ba'i yum 'di yang*// de phyir rnam mang rol mo mdzad la 'dud// sems dpa' mchog dang mchod pa'i lha mo dang*// 'gug sogs las mkhan nyid kyang snang tshogs thabs// rnam mang gdul bya nyid dang gcig sbyor ched// yin shes gnyis med dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// de nas lha yi 'khor lo snang ba'i yul na ma grub/ btags pa'i don stong pas sgyu ma'i dpes mtshon pa ci tsam bsgom nus pa de tsam bsgom par bya'o// de nas rol mo drag po dang bcas pas/ mda' dar g.yob spos btul/ dbyangs snyan pos/ shar gyi sgo ma rdo rje lcags kyu ma// dkar mo zhi ba'i mkha' 'gro kun gyis bskor// phyag na tshe yi g.yab dar dkar po bsnams// tshe dpal gzi brjid bskyed pa'i mthu stobs can// shar phyogs dri za'i lag gi tshe drongs la// steng 'og phyogs mtshams sa yi bcud gang dang*// tshe bsring g.yang che dpal dang gzi bskyed pa'i// rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gug pa'i las mdzod cig

/oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ lho yi sgo ma rdo rje zhags pa ma// ser mo rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro kun gyis bskor// phyag na tshe yi g.yab dar ser po bsnams// tshe dpal gzi brjid bskyed pa'i mthu stobs can// lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag gi tshe drongs la// steng 'og phyogs mtshams chu yi bcud gang dang*// tshe bsring g.yang che dpal dang gzi bskyed pa'i// rin chen tshe mchog 'gug pa'i las mdzod cig /oṃ hrīḥbh+rūṃ rat+na dzñā na a yu ṣe badz+ra pā sha hūm̐// nub kyi sgo ma rdo rje lcags sgrog ma// dmar mo dbang gi mkha' 'gro kun gyis bskor// phyag na tshe yi g.yab dar dmar po bsnams// tshe dpal gzi brjid bskyed pa'i mthu stobs can// nub phyogs klu dbang lag gi tshe drongs la// steng 'og phyogs mtshams me yi bcud gang dang*// tshe bsring g.yang che dpal dang gzi bskyed pa'i// pad+ma'i tshe mchog 'gug pa'i las mdzod cig /oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ pad+ma dzñā na a yu ṣe badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐// byang gi sgo ma rdo rje dril bu ma// ljang mo las kyi mkha' 'gro kun gyis bskor// phyag na tshe yi g.yab dar ljang khu bsnams// tshe dpal gzi brjid bskyed pa'i mthu stobs can// byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag gi tshe drongs la/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams rlung gi bcud gang dang*// tshe bsring g.yang che dpal dang gzi bskyed pa'i// las kyi tshe mchog 'gug pa'i las mdzod cig /oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ karma dzñā na ā yu ṣe badz+ra a we sha ya hoḥ dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs thugs ka nas// 'od zer lcags kyu zhags sgrog dril bu'i tshul// rgyal ba 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhing khyab pas// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i tshe'i dngos grub// dag pa'i tshe rdzas 'di la 'gug par mdzod// oṃ hrīḥbhūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ om̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe swā hā/

oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta ā yur dzñā na su bi ni tsit+ta te dz+wa ra dza ya/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñān a yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ rat+na dzñā= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma dzñā= oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ karma dzñā= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta ā yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dzo rā dza ya/ a pa ri mi ta ā yur dzñā na su bi ni swā hā/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐/ badz+ra ā be sha ya hoḥ ces tshe'i bum pa la dgug gzhugs yang yang bya/ dmigs pa de kho na'o// gtso bo dang 'khor gyi lha re re'i thugs kar tshe'i bum pa rang rigs kyi phyag mtshan dang mthun pa'i nang du/ gtso bo rnams la hrīḥhūm̐ trāṃ bh+rūm̐ āḥ rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba/ yum lnga la/ pāṃ māṃ trāṃ lāṃ tāṃ/ yum sngags kyis bskor ba/ sems dpa' rnams la hūm̐ trāṃ bh+rūm̐ āḥ rigs kyi sngags kyis bskor ba/ mchod lhar/ māṃ trāṃ lāṃ tāṃ/ yum sngags kyis bskor ba/ sgo ma la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang sngags kyis bskor ba/ de ltar sngags phreng sa bon gsal ba las bdud rtsi chi li li bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur sar bsam nas/ sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra= gtso bo lnga'i snying po/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na su bi ni tsit+ta te dz+wa ra dza ya= yum lnga'i snying po/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe swa hā/ oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ rat+na= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma= om̐ āḥbh+rūm̐ karma= sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pā ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi ni tsit+ta te dz+wa rā dza ya= mchod lha'i snying po/ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi ni swā hā/ sgo ma'i snying po/ sngags phreng rnams zhu ba bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pas de khol zhing lud/

ches cher 'phel bas lha so so'i sku thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa thams cad dag bar chad gdon bgegs thams cad bcom nas dbang bzhi thob// 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur/ spro na rgyas gdab bya'o// bdag bskyed kho na'i skabs bsdu ldang bya zhing*/ gtor ma 'bul/ bsnyen pa'i man ngag go/ ༈ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ mdun bskyed kyi rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum de'i nang du rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor lhun po'i steng du phyi me ri dang*/ rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba'i nang sna tshogs pad+ma la rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i lte ba la gzhal yas khang rin po che sngo ser dkar ljang dmar ba'i rtsigs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ de'i khyams shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dkar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dang lha snam dmar po/ lte bar āḥlas zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma/ steng du pad+ma hrīḥdang paṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sems cad thams cad kyi tshe'i bar chad bsal/ thar pa la bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byas te/ de dag gi byin rlabs bsdus te hrīḥl thim nas zhu ba'i thig le las bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa li khri'i khu ba lta bur dmar ba/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi ba med pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa bsnams te yum la 'khyud pa/ shin tu zhi zhing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pa lta ba'i mig ngom pa med pa'i sku zur phud kyi rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang*/

dar zab kyis legs par brgyan pa 'od zer gyi snang ba mtha' yas pa 'gyed cing rdo rje skyil krung gis zla nyi la bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul dang zhabs pad+ma'i gdan gyi sked pa nas 'khril ba mtshar sdug yid kyis bris pa lta bur mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho la gnas pa'o// shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod tshe dpag med sngon po mnyam bzhag gi steng na baiḍūr+ya'i tshe bum bsnams pa/ lhor rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa las rin 'byung tshe dpag med ser po mnyam bzhag gi steng na gser gyi tshe bum bsnams pa/ nub tu 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang tshe dpag med dkar po mnyam bzhag gi steng na shel gyi tshe bum bsnams pa/ byang du ral gri āḥs mtshan pa las don grub tshe dpag med ljang kha mnyam bzhag gi steng na in+d+ra nī la'i tshe bum bsnams pa/ shin tu zhi zhing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pa lta ba'i mig ngom pa med pa'i sku/ zur phud kyi rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang*/ dar zab kyis legs par brgyan pa 'od zer gyi snang ba mtha' yas pa 'gyed cing rdo rje skyil krung gis zla nyi la bzhugs pa/ shar lhor māṃ las mā ma ki sngo ba g.yas rdo rje/ lho nub tu trāṃ las sgrol ma gser mdog g.yas rin po che/ nub byang du lāṃ las sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ byang shar du tāṃ las dam tshig sgrol ma ljang sngon g.yas ral gri/ thams cad kyang g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshar sdug yid kyis bris pa lta bu'i mdzes pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho la gnas pa'o// shar gyi snam bur hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' bzhi mthing kha g.yas rdo rje/

lhor trāṃ traṃ' trāṃ trāṃ las rin chen sems dpa' bzhi ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub tu oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ las rnam snang sems dpa' bzhi dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ byang du ā ā ā ā las las kyi sems dpa' bzhi ljang kha g.yas ral gri/ thams cad kyis g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ lha'i dbang phyug lta bur mdzes shing rgyan thams cad dang dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu spras pa'o// phyi'i grwa bzhi'i mer māṃ las bdug spos ma sngo sangs/ bden bral du trāṃ las mar me ma gur gum gyi mdog rlung du lam las me tog ma dkar mo/ dbang ldan du tāṃ las dri chab ma dmar skya/ shar sgor dzaḥlas lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor hūm̐ las zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor bam̐ las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor hoḥlas dril bu ma ljang khu brgyad po phyag g.yas rang ming gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ lha'i na chung mtshar mo rgyan dang gos kyis mdzes pa 'khril ldem gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'o// lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas nas bsgom pa ji lta ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// gdod nas dag pa thugs rje'i gzugs// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon lta'i// gsung gi dbang phyug tshe dpag med// rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas// ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'gro ba'i don la spyan 'dren na// tshe zad tshe nyams gso ba'i phyir// myur ba nyid du gshegs su gsol// rdo rje rin chen rnam snang dang*// las kyi rigs mchog tshe dpag med// yum bzhi sems dpa' bcu drug dang*// mchod pa'i lha mo sgo mar bcas// tshe dang ye shes rgyas pa dang*// mchog gi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren na// byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ

dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs bskrad par mdzad pas dbang bskur lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag po sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa rnams kyis/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// gzugs mdzes dkar mo rdo rje dril bu ma// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

tshigs bcad kyi thog mtha' gnyis dang sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra/ dkyil 'khor= yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdug spos 'thul ba'i= nam mkha'= dhu pe= dkyil 'khor= kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu dang*// mar mes gang ba'i= nam mkha'= ā lo ke= dkyil 'khor= gdung sel ljang khu rdo rje= dri mchog byug pa'i rin chen= nam mkha'= gan+dhe= dkyil 'khor= zhal zas ser mo= bdud rtsi'i gang= nam mkha'= nai wi d+ya= dkyil 'khor= sgra snyan sna tshogs= pi waṃ gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma// nam mkha'= shap+ta= dzam bu'i gser las rang byung lte ba zlum// rtsibs stong mu khyud mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba// mkha' la rab 'phags phyogs las rgyal byed pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ thal dkar mche ba drug pa zla 'od can// chu zheng phun tshogs yud kyis mkha' lam nas// sa chen rgya mtsho'i ska rags can bskor ba'i// glang po rin chen= hasti rat+na= spu kha rma bya'i mgrin 'dra yid 'ong zhing*// gser gyi rgyan ldan mgyogs pa yid lta bus// tho rangs sa rnams bskor te slar ldog pa'i// rta mchog rin chen= a shwa rat+na= kun tu sngo ba snang byed baiḍūr+ya// nyin mor byed pa 'od kyis rnam gnon cing*// bsam pa rdzogs byed legs sbyangs cha brgyad pa// nor bu rin chen= ma ṇi rat+na= 'chi med bu mo bzhin du gzugs mdzes shing*// reg bya mchog gis lus sems brtas byed pa// sgyu rtsal kun shes smra mkhas dri bzang gter// btsun mo rin chen= s+t+ri rat+na= phur bu'i blo ldan mdzangs shing yid gzhung pa// 'khor yug gter gyi 'dod dgu 'dzud byed cing*// des pa snyan pa'i tshig 'byin lha mig can// khyim bdag rin= pu ru ṣa rat+na= sred med bu yi stobs ldan dpa' ba dang*// brtul phod yid la brgyus pa'i don rnams kun// mod la sgrub cing phas rgol med byed pa// blon po rin chen=

kharga rat+na= 'od zer gyis sngo ral gri lpags pa 'jam// dga' ba'i nags tshal gos ni yid rjes 'gro// mthu ldan mchil lahwam khang khyim gzhal du med// reg 'jam gzim cha= u pa rat+na= pad can dung ltar rab dkar zla bzhin ma// dpal gyi be'u thogs nas snyem pa yis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pa kun tu shis gyur cig shrī waras+ya= 'jigs byed kun+da'i 'od can lus phra ma// gser gyi 'khor lo 'chang ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= su war+ṇa tsakra= 'od can mthon mthing bcu drug lang tsho ma// rin chen 'dab brgya bzung nas rol rtsed kyis// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= pad+ma kun+dza ra= rnam rgyal sngo skya 'dod pa'i dbyangs mkhan ma// rgyal mtshan bsgreng zhing ga ma kas bcing glus// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= kun+dha dh+wa dza= mdangs ldan li khri'i rdul 'chang mig yangs ma// mu tig gdugs dkar bskor zhing zur mig mdas// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= si ta ta pa tra= dkar sham mtshams sprin mdog can gzugs mdzes ma// gter gyi bum pas lag brel rtsed 'jo yis// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= ni dhi gha ṭa= dri med margad mdangs ldan dpal ldan ma// g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung bsnams 'jo sgeg gis// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= shaṅkha waras+ya= yid gzhung rma bya'i mgrin 'dra dga' skyed ma/ gser gyi nya 'dzin 'gying gzugs glog 'dra bas// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= ka na ka maras+ya= phyi mchod do// mthon mthing 'od chags rdo rje pi waṃ ma// rgyud mang snyan pa'i skad kyi yid sgyur byed// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// tshe dpag med khyod rdo rje'i yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra wi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ mchog gi gser mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// snyan 'gyur rin chen gling bu'i sgra dbyangs can// rdo rje rig= tshe dpag med= waṃ she= bim pa ltar dmar rdo rje rdza rnga ma// skad snyan lha rdzas bzang po'i rdza rnga 'khrol// rdo rje rigs=

tshe dpag= mu rañdze= margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga chen ma// rnga chen cher sgrogs nam mkha'i phyogs kun 'gengs// rdo rje= tshe dpag= mṛ taṃ ge= pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan bzhad pa mo// 'dzum zhal dgyes pa'i bzhin gyis kun dga' bskyed// rdo rje= tshe= ha s+ya= mthon ka chen po'i 'od 'dzin rab sgeg ma// rdo rje dril 'chang dkur brten snyem pa'i tshul// rdo rje= tshe= lā s+ya= btso ma'i gser mdog rdo rje glu dbyangs ma// shes rab dbyangs snyan rna ba'i bcud len mkhan// rdo rje= tshe= girti= rma bya'i spu ltar sngo ljang gar mkhan ma// mnyen lcug yan lag mchog gi bro gar bsgyur// rdo rje= tshe= nit+ti= ston zla ltar dkar rdo rje me tog ma// lha rdzas me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs byed// rdo rje= tshe= puṣ+pe= sngo skya dud sprin rdo rje bdug pa ma// mkha' khyab dri zhim bdug pa'i spos sprin can// rdo rje= tshe= dhū pe= gur gum gzhon nu'i lus can snang gsal ma// rin chen snang bas phyogs bcu'i mun sel byed/ rdo rje= tshe= ā lo ke= /'char ka'i mdangs ltar dmar skya byug pa ma// legs sbyar dri mchog dge bas rnyog pa sel// rdo rje= tshe= gan+dhe= kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar gzugs can ma// rnam dag rin chen dngul dkar me long g.yob// rdo rje= tshe= rū pa= leb rgan rtsi ltar lus dmar ro ldan ma// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas 'dzin// rdo rje= tshe= rā s+ye= dūr ba'i 'dab ltar ljang ser reg bya ma// reg pa'i bde ba mchog ster na bza' 'dzin/ rdo rje= tshe= spar+she= kun+da ku muta rgyas 'dra chos dbyings ma// rgyal ba kun bskyed skye gnas phyag rgya can// rdo rje= tshe= dharma dhā tu= dkyil 'khor mdun gyi bdud rtsi/ oṃ ma dag pa sbyangs/ āḥmang por spel/ hūm̐ bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga'i rang bzhin du sbar/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hoḥ lan gsum/ rgyal ba tshe dang 'od snang mtha' yas zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i zhal du= grub brnyes badz+ra kirti'i= rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i= chos rgyal zla 'od gzhon nu'i= 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i= grub thob pad+ma badz+ra= gdung dang na bza'i mtshan can= mnyam med seṅge'i mtshan dgu'i= sprul sku rigs gsum rnam 'phrul= rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor= 'brug chen ngag dbang chos rgyal= kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bu'i= grub brnyes ngag dbang bzang po'i= rgyal ba dpag bsam dbang po'i yongs 'dzin kun dga' lhun grub= mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug= mchog sprul chos rgyal dpal bzang= ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin= 'dren mchog chos rgyal rgya mtsho'i= bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i= rgyal dbang chos kyi snang ba'i= mi pham 'jam dpal rdo rje'i= rje btsun sgrub brgyud nyi ma'i= drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i= ris med rgya bod bla ma'i= oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dz+wa ra dza ya sarba= oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe= oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ rat+na badz+ra dzñā na= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma badz+ra dzñā= oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ karma= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dzo rā dza ya sarba= a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi ni sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ nang mchod do// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi zhal du= gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal du= bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i= gzhan yang mchod 'os rgya mtsho'i= kha raṃ khā hi/ mdzes ma 'di dag phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rigs lnga las byung 'di phul bas// rig pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin shog

yum dang rjes su chags pa mdzad pas bde stong chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gsang mchod do// rang rdzas mdzes pa nyid kyi rdzas// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*/ stong pa chen po'i rgyu de yis// thams cad stong pa mngon sum du// byas la bde chen skad cig gis// rdzogs par byas la mchod par bya/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// bstod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyi mthar/ hrīḥ 'gro la rjes su chags pa dmar ba'i sku// sogs gong ltar gyis/ yin shes gnyis med dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// de nas tshe 'gug bya ba ni/ bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa bzhis mda' dar g.yob cing*/ shar gyi sgo ma rdo rje lcags kyu ma// ces sogs gong gi bdag bskyed skabs ltar gyi tshe 'gug rdzogs pa'i bar 'dir bya/ gtso bo dang 'khor gyi lha re re'i thugs kar tshe yi bum pa rang rigs kyi phyag mtshan dang mthun pa'i nang du// gtso bo rnams la/ hrīḥhūm̐ trāṃ bh+rūm̐ āḥ rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba/ yum lnga la/ pāṃ māṃ trāṃ lāṃ tāṃ/ yum sngags kyis bskor ba/ sems dpa' rnams la/ hūm̐ trāṃ bh+rūm̐ āḥ yab sngags kyis bskor ba/ mchod lhar/ māṃ trāṃ lāṃ tāṃ/ yum sngags kyis bskor ba/ sgo ma la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang sngags kyis bskor ba/ de ltar sa bon sngags phreng gsal ba las bdud rtsi chi li li bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā= oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ ā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta ā yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dz+wa ra dza ya/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ rat+na= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma= oṃ ā bh+rūm̐ karma= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dz+wa rā dza ya/ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi ni swā hā/ spro na mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs 'don pa mi 'gal shin tu legs/

sngags phreng rnams zhu ba bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pas de khol zhing lud ches cher 'phel bas lha so so'i sku thams cad gang bar gyur// ༈ bum bskyed ni/ de nas bum pa bzang po lnga las bum dang drug gam/ shin tu spros pa bskyung na gnyis kyang rung*/ de la phyag mtshan bkod/ bum sman nyer lnga btab pa'i chus sum gnyis dgang*/ mgul ching dang kha rgyan 'bras bu bzang po can gyi shing lo'am ku shas brgyan/ sna tshogs pad+ma'am ras sam ku sha'i gdan la go rim bzhin bkod/ mchod pa dang bdud rtsi gtor ma rnams bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las phyi bum pa nang gzhal yas khang du pad+ma'i sdong po'i lte bar āḥlas zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma/ steng du pad+ma hrīḥdang paṃ gyi mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe'i bar chad bsal/ thar pa la bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byas te/ de dag gi byin rlabs bsdus te hrīḥl thim nas zhu ba'i thig le las/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa li khri'i khu ba lta bur dmar ba/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi ba med pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa bsnams te yum la 'khyud pa shin tu zhi zhing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pas lta ba'i mig ngom pa med pa'i sku/ zur phud kyi rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang dar zab kyis legs par brgyan pa/ 'od zer gyi snang ba mtha' yas pa 'gyed cing rdo rje skyil krung gis zla nyi la bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul dang*/ zhabs pad+ma'i gdan gyi sked pa nas 'khril ba/

mtshar sdug yid kyis bris pa lta bur mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho la gnas pa'o// shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod tshe dpag med sngon po mnyam bzhag gi steng na baiḍūr+ya'i tshe bum bsnams pa/ lhor rin po che trām̐ gis mtshan pa las rin 'byung tshe dpag med ser po mnyam bzhag gi steng na gser gyi tshe bum bsnams pa/ nub tu 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang tshe dpag med dkar po mnyam bzhag gi steng na shel gyi tshe bum bsnams pa/ byang du ral gri aḥs mtshan pa las don grub tshe dpag med ljang kha mnyam bzhag gi steng na in+d+ra nī la'i tshe bum bsnams pa shin tu zhi zhing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pas lta ba'i mig ngom pa med pa'i sku/ zur phud kyi rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang dar zab legs par brgyan pa/ 'od zer gyi snang ba mtha' yas pa 'gyed cing rdo rje skyil krung gis zla nyi la bzhugs pa/ shar lhor māṃ las mā ma ki sngo ba g.yas rdo rje/ lho nub tu trām̐ las sgrol ma gser mdog g.yas rin po che/ nub byang du laṃ las sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ byang shar du tām̐ las dam tshig sgrol ma ljang sngon g.yas ral gri// thams cad kyang g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa mtshar sdug yid kyis bris pa lta bur mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho la gnas pa'o// shar du hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' bzhi mthing ga g.yas rdo rje/ lhor trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ las rin chen sems dpa' bzhi ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub tu oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ las rnam snang sems dpa' bzhi dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ byang du ā ā ā ā las las kyi sems dpa' bzhi ljang kha g.yas ral gri/ thams cad kyis g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

lha'i dbang phyug lta bur mdzes shing rgyan thams cad dang dar zab kyis lhab lhub tu spras pa'o// phyi yi gra bzhi'i mer māṃ las bdug spos ma sngo sangs/ bden bral du trāṃ las mar me ma gur gum gyi mdog rlung du laṃ las me tog ma dkar mo// dbang ldan du taṃ las dri chab ma dmar skya/ shar du dzaḥlas lcags kyu ma dkar mo// lhor hūm̐ las zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub tu bam̐ las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang du hoḥlas dril bu ma ljang khu/ brgyad po phyag g.yas rang ming gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ lha'i na chung mtshar mo rgyan dang gos kyi mdzes pa 'khril ldem gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ las thams cad par khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rtsa ba'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljang 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang*/ sma ra ser po/ steng du rta zhal ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug tho 'phyar bas bgegs dang 'byung po ma lus pa 'joms shing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i rtser me 'bar bas gnod byed pa lus pa bsreg pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i cod paṇa dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa brgya'i phyed kyi do shal dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ glang po che'i ko ba dang*/ mi yi pags pas stod g.yogs pa/ stag lpags rlon pas smad dkris pa/ cis kyang mi tshugs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin gshin rje'i gzugs lta bu'i sku las bskal pa'i me'i phung po steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du dmar 'ur 'ur 'phro ba zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bdud bzhi brdzis te pad+ma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas nas sgom pa ji lta ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo chen po mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// gdod nas dag pa thugs rje'i gzugs// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon lta'i// gsung gi dbang phyug tshe dpag med// rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas// ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'gro ba'i don tu spyan 'dren na// tshe zad tshe nyams gso ba'i phyir// myur ba nyid du gshegs su gsol// rdo rje rin chen rnam snang dang*// las kyi rigs mchog tshe dpag med// yum bzhi sems dpa' bcu drug dang*// mchod pa'i lha mo sgo mar bcas// tshe dang ye shes rgyas pa dang*// mchog gi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag gi dad pas spyan 'dren na// byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod par mdzad pas dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag po sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ yid las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis// lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar// lha yi dri yis nye bar byug /me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la// gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ tsan+da gur gum sbyar ba yi// dri mchog byug spos dam pa 'di// dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la bzhes su gsol/ dhu pe= mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba 'di// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed cing*// lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di// bdag la dgongs te bzhes su gsol/

dī paṃ= sna tshogs lha yi dri dang ldan// sna tshogs ga pur gyis ni brgyan// sna tshogs hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// dri mchog 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ gan+dhe= kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs pa// zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ nai wi d+ya= pa tra ha dang cang te'u dang*// rnga dang dung sogs sgra dbyangs dang*// yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs pa// tshe dpag med pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ shap+ta= zhing 'dir rgyal srid sna bdun gyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i phyir// nyin bzhin shes rab can gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥrat+na sap+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rab mdzes lta bas ming ngom lang tsho can// dga' ba'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga ma// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra wi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ waṃ she= mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ ge= rab mdzes= mchog dga'i nyams= bzhad dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs gar mkhan mas// rab 'byams= ha s+ya= lā s+ya= girti= nirti= rab mdzes= khyad dga'i nyams= me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri chab ma// rab 'byams= puṣ+pe= dhu pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= rab mdzes= lhan skyes dga' bzhis= gzugs bcud reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje mas// rab 'byams= rū pa= rā s+ya= spar+she= dharma dhartu=

bum pa'i bdud rtsi/ oṃ ma dag pa sbyangs/ āḥmang po spel/ hūm̐ bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga'i rang bzhin du sbar/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum/ oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe swa hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na= oṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ swa= oṃ āḥhūm̐= oṃ oṃ= oṃ āḥhūm̐= oṃ āḥ= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dze rā dza ya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐= oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ swā bh+rūm̐ rat+na= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā bh+rūm̐ karma= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dzo rā dza ya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi ni swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yum dang rjes su chags par mdzad pa'i bde stong chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang rdzas mdzes pa nyid kyi rdzas// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa chen po rgyu de yis// thams cad stong pa mngon sum du// byas la bde chen skad cig gis// rdzogs par byas la mchod par bya// bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ 'gro la rjes su chags pa dmar ba'i sku// sogs gong ltar/ yin shes gnyis med dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// las bum la/ hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rta mchog sku// nyi ma'i 'od mtshungs nyon mongs bsreg /bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo rta mgrin phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo rnams la/ hrīḥhūm̐ trām̐ bh+rūm̐ āḥ rang rang sngags kyis bskor ba/ yum lnga la/ paṃ maṃ trāṃ laṃ tāṃ/ yum sngags kyis bskor ba/ sems dpa' rnams la/ hūm̐ trāṃ bh+rūm̐ āḥ rigs kyi sngags kyis bskor ba/ mchod lhar/ maṃ trāṃ laṃ tāṃ/ yum sngags kyis bskor ba/ sgo ma la/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang sngags kyis bskor ba/ de ltar sa bon sngags phreng gsal ba las bdud rtsi chi li li bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/

oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzā na a yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐= oṃ swa bhūm̐= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dz+wa rā dza ya/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rum̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ swa bh+rūm̐ rat+na= oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma= oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ karma= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi niṣatsi ta te dzo rā dza ya/ a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi ni swā hā/ sngags phreng rnams zhu ba bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pas/ de khol zhing lud ches cher 'phel bas lha so so'i sku thams cad gang*/ mthar rnam par rgyal ba'i lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bum chu la thim par gyur/ las bum bzlas pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ ci rigs 'don/ rta mgrin gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ swa bhā wa/ sogs kyis gtor ma sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du las ma rdzogs kyi bar du bzhugs par gyur/ bum pa'i cho ga'o// thun mtshams su bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma chang bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ oṃ ma dag pa sbyangs/ āḥmang por spel/ hūm̐ bdud rtsi lnga dang sgrol ma lnga'i rang bzhin du sbar/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dkyil 'khor chen po phyogs skyong bcu'i 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs// oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu= oṃ swa= oṃ oṃ= oṃ ā= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi ta=

ra dza ya i dam= oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐= oṃ swa= oṃ oṃ= oṃ āḥ= oṃ bh+rūm̐ a pa ri mi sogs/ rā dza ya i daṃ= a pa ri mi ta a yur dzñā na su bi ni i daṃ= re re la lan gsum gyis lha tshogs rnams la phul/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dus 'di nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis 'jig rten par phul/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun grub cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// zhes 'dod don gsol/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang la thim// 'jig rten pa rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas bdag 'jug ni/ slob ma la bskur ba'i rim pa ji lta bas te/ oṃ badz+ra urga ra sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi phye ba'i shar sgo nas zhugs te shar khyams su 'khod par bsam la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas/ bgegs gtor ni/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha dang lha min bgegs tshogs nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'gro bar gyis// gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// lus rnams stong du gyur nas ni// rnam par 'joms pa gdon mi za// de bas khyod rnams gzhan du dengs/ rta sngags dang*/ sum bha nis bskrad/ bsrung 'khor gsal 'debs pa ni/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rtsa ba'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dang*/ smin ma dang sma ra ser po/ steng du rta zhal ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/

phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug tho 'phyar bas bgegs dang 'byung po ma lus pa 'joms shing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i rtser me 'bar bas gnod byed ma lus pa bsreg pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i cod paṇa dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa brgya'i phyed kyi do shal dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ glang po che'i ko ba dang*/ mi'i pags pas stod g.yogs pa/ stag lpags rlon pas smad dkris pa/ cis kyang mi tshugs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin gshin rje'i gzugs lta bu'i sku las bskal pa'i me'i phung po steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du dmar 'ur 'ur 'phro ba zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bdud bzhi brdzis te pad+ma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ srid pa gsum zil gyis gnon pa nam mkha'i khams khyab pa bzhin du gyur/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su hrīḥ de las pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bgegs bar du gcod pa'i gdon 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde dpung thams cad kyi snying gar lcags kyus btab/ zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus mnyes te brgyal zhing 'bog pa mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bsad gtub mes bsregs pas thal ba tsam yang mi dmigs par gyur/ 'jug yon/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ sogs nas/ tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i zhes sogs 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mig dar bcing*/ bu khyed su yin ci la dga'/ dri/ bdag ni skal bzang rigs yin no// zhes lan gdab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol//

lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// tshe dpag med pa'i grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// gnang ba sbyin par gyur/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes me tog gi phreng ba bzung*/ shar sgo la sogs sgo bzhi nas phyag bya bar mos/ oṃ na ma te hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na ma mo na ma hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas so// de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzo paṣ+tha na ya at+ma naṃ/ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha maṃ/ na ma te hūm̐= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzo a bhi ṣe ka ya āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ na ma= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzo pra warta na ya/ āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra warta ya maṃ/ oṃ na mo= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzo karma ni at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru ta maṃ/ oṃ na ma= zhes pa shar nas zhugs/ lho nas dbang*/ nub nas chos bshad/ byang nas phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gsol ba gdab bo// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs spyi'i rgyun bshags bya/ khyad par sdom pa bsgrag pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen gyis ni bzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par bshad/ rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya// de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni// phas pham par ni rab tu bshad// spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste// rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do//

sdom pa bzung ba ni/ tshe dpag med pa dag dang ni// bde gshegs 'tsho zhing gzhes pa rnams// 'di nyid nas bzung sangs rgyas bar// bdag la dgongs shing gzigs par mdzod// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te mchog tu bzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bya// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang*// rang gi dam tshig bsrung ba dang*// bdag gi dge ba'i las kyis ni// myur du sangs rgyas bsgrub bya ste// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi// lan gsum/ de nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa dā ya mi/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+wam̐ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa'o// de nas dam la bzhag pa'i phyir/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs kun dang*// tshe dpag med pa'i dngos grub thob// dngos grub gzhan ni lta ci smos// dkyil 'khor ma zhugs la mi smra// smras na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ rdo rje mgo bor bkod/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// gal te khyod kyis smras gyur na// dam tshig rdo rje chen po yis// mgo bo 'gas par gyur ta re/

phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o// de nas rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ tshe dpag med pa deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag bdud rtsi blud de/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi// tshe dpag med pa nga yin gyis// khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa na// mi dge ma spang dus byas nas// dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re// slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag de nas byin dbab pa'i don tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la// tshe dpag med pa dbab tu gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bdag nyid kyi rkang mthil rlung gi dkyil 'khor la dzhaiṃ/ snying gar lam las sa yi dkyil 'khor/ mgrin par baṃ las chu yi dkyil 'khor/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung dang haṃ/ de'i steng du tshe dpag med yab yum 'od kyi rang bzhin gar mdzad pa'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dzag pa rang gi lus la thim pas zag med kyi bde bas gang ba'i mthar rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya a/ s+t+wam̐ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra tsā la ya hūm̐ aḥha dzhaiṃḥ rol mo dang gu gul zla mtshan thod par dur khrod kyi ye la bsreg pas bdug bab par gyur na/ lce steng du āḥlas bdud rtsi bab par bsam/ bh+rām̐ hrīḥbadz+ra/ smros shig rdo rje can gyi rigs zhes gsungs par bsam/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya'o// de nas me tog bum pa'i mtshan ma'am tshom bu la dngos su dor/ yid kyi dkyil 'khor la dor bar dmigs nas/ tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe ye shes brnyes pa'i lha// gang yin de la 'bab par shog

/pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ rigs brtags/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ phog pa'i lha des rang gi mgo bor bcings bar mos/ tshe dpag med pa deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ mig dar 'grol/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni tshe dpag med rigs skye// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub kun khyod mngon du gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bkra lam gyis mthong bar gyur/

'jug pa'o// dbang la bzhi las dang po bum dbang gi don du/ bla ma sprul sku bdag nyid can gyi drung du bum dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ sa gzhi zhes sogs man+ḍal/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// yab yum gnyis med bde chen sku// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i khri la bdag nyid 'khod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs las sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ bum pa thams cad kyi chu rnam rgyal du bsdus la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ sgo ma rnams kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs skrod par mdzad pas/ gsang gsum dam tshig las byung ba'i// ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mi bskyod pa chu yi dbang gis nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gis bsags pa'i sdig pa dag rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slob ma dang cod pan/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi cod paṇa mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las trāṃ las rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ rin 'byung zhu ba cod pan du gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i cod paṇa dar dpyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod la/ sgo ma rnams kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs skrod par mdzad pas/ cod pan mgo bor bzhag/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyis brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yis/ rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*/ dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rin chen 'byung gnas cod paṇa gyi dbang gis/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi dbang gis bsags pa'i sdig pa dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ slob ma dang rdo rje/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyis phyag rgya mdzad pa rgyan gyis brgyan te rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros// ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ snang mtha' zhu ba rdo rjer gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rdo rjes dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod la/ sgo ma rnams kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bskrod par mdzad pas/ rdo rje g.yas su gtad/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun nas rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs/

oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti tiṣ+ṭha a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi dbang gis bsags pa'i sdig pa dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slob ma dang dril bu/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi dril bu mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas don yod grub pa ljang kha skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ don grub zhu ba dril bur gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis dril bus dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod la/ sgo ma rnams kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bskrod par mdzad pas/ dril bu g.yon du gtad cing dkrol/ thabs dang shes rab dang ldan pas// 'gro don mnyam med byed pa yi// mchod pa'i phrin las rdzogs byed pa// dril bu las kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ a dhi pa ta ye a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa phrag dog gis bsags pa'i sdig pa dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slob ma/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyi ming gi dbang bskur/

mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod la/ sgo ma rnams kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs skrod par mdzad pas/ mgo bor rdo rje dril bu bzhag/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// byang chub snying po'i bar du ni// cis kyang gzhom par mi nus pa'i// rdo rje'i ming ni rab tu grags// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta maṃ/ badz+ra na maḥ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin ming gi dbang gis/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gis bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ dbang lha bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ nyon mongs lnga ni rnam dag pa'i// dbang bskur lnga ni thob pa yin// ma rig pa las 'das nas kyang*// ye shes lnga ni thob pa yin// zhes dbang don bshad nas slar yang tshe bum tshe chang sogs rdzas rnams la tshe 'gug pa ni/ shar gyi sgo ma rdo rje lcags kyu ma// sogs nas/ dag pa'i tshe rdzas 'di la 'gug par mdzod/ ces pa'i bar tshe 'gug tshang ma sngags bcas 'don/ de nas tshe bstim pa'i phyir/ tshe dbang bskur ba ni/ rnam snang tshe dpag med yab yum gyi thugs ka'i bdud rtsi sbyor mtshams nas spyi bor bab pas bde chen 'khor lo gang*/ lus 'chi ba med pa sku rdo rje'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ tshe bum dkar po spyi bor bkod/ rnam snang yab yum thugs ka'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun// gnyis med sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mkhar babs nas// 'di ni mi nub rgyal mtshan lta bu'i tshe// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// sku yi dngos grub ma lus thob gyur cig /oṃ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe ka a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ gtso bo yab yum thugs ka'i bdud rtsi sbyor mtshams nas mgrin par bab pas longs spyod 'khor lo gang*/ ngag 'chi ba med pa gsung gi dngos grub thob par gyur/ tshe bum dmar po mgrin par bzhag gtso bo yab yum thugs ka'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun// gnyis med sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mkhar babs pas// 'di ni mi shig rdo rje lta bu'i tshe// skal ldan rigs kyi=

gsung gi dngos= oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe ka a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ mi bskyod tshe dpag med yab yum kyi thugs ka'i bdud rtsi sbyor mtshams nas snying gar bab pas chos kyi 'khor lo gang*/ yid 'chi ba med pa thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ tshe bum sngon po snying khar bzhag mi bskyod yab yum thugs ka'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun// gnyis med sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mkhar bab pas// 'di ni mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bu'i tshe// skal ldan= thugs kyi dngos= oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na ā yu ṣe ka a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rin 'byung tshe dpag med yab yum gyi thugs ka'i bdud rtsi sbyor mtshams nas lte bar bab pas sprul pa'i 'khor lo gang*/ nus mthu 'chi ba med pa yon tan rdo rje'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ tshe bum ser po lte bar bzhag rin 'byung yab yum thugs ka'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ gnyis med= 'di ni gsal rdzogs nyi zla lta bu'i tshe// skal ldan= yon tan dngos grub= oṃ swa bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe ka a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ don grub tshe dpag med yab yum gyi thugs ka'i bdud rtsi sbyor mtshams nas gsang bar bab pas bde skyong 'khor lo gang*/ 'gro don 'chi ba med pa phrin las rdo rje'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ tshe bum ljang kha gsang bar bzhag don grub yab yum= gnyis med= 'di ni bsam 'phel nor bu lta bu'i tshe// skal ldan= phrin las= oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ so so tshe ril tshe chang longs spyod/ tshe yi bdud rtsi rnams kyi dwangs ma tshe gzugs 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang gnas su so sor 'khod pas rgyas gdab par gyur/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya spyi bor bkod/ sku yi rdo rje'i lha tshogs la// skal ldan rigs kyi bu 'di yi// tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdom// 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas rgyas thob cig/

pad+ma'i phyag rgya mgrin par bzhag gsung gi rdo rje'i= skal ldan= tshe 'di bcol= pad+ma'i phyag rgyas= rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying khar bzhag thugs kyi rdo rje'i= skal ldan= tshe 'di= rdo rje'i phyag rgyas= rin po che'i phyag rgya lte bar bzhag yon tan rdo rje'i= skal ldan= tshe 'di= rin chen phyag rgyas= rgya gram phyag rgya gsang bar bzhag las kyi rdo rje'i= skal ldan= tshe 'di= sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas thob cig/ de'i mthar/ dbus kyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis don gyi lha// snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pas de 'dir shis par shog /shar gyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// mi bskyod rdo rje'i bkra shis don gyi lha// mi bskyod rdo rje'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir shis par shog /lho yi phyogs= rin chen 'byung gnas= rin chen 'byung= bkra shis= nub kyi= rnam par snang mdzad= rnam par snang mdzad= bkra shis= byang gi= don yod grub= don yod= bkra shis= de nas/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing dril bu dkur brten pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs bstan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e kha ya s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyem tshul bdag po'i bdag/ zhes rdo rje bzung*/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod rnams kyis ni rtag tu bcangs// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces dril bu bzung*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi bdag

/ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byed// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// ces dril bu dkrol/ rdo rje dril bu'i yang dag 'khyud// dpal gnas ma dang sgrol snyem 'chang*// bde ba chen po'i dam tshig ni// deng 'dir rtag tu bzung bar bgyi// zhes 'khyud stangs bya bas dam tshig gsum bzung*/ de nas/ mtshan ma med pa 'gro ba'i don// gang dag bdag gi byed nus pa// phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur mchog /dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ shar phyogs su seng ge'i khri la bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med pa li khri'i khu ba lta bur dmar ba phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya/ zhes pa nas gtso bo yab yum kyi mngon rtogs/ brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho la gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i bar bsgom/ de'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phub par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang bas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod la/ sgo ma rnams kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bskrod par mdzad pas/ rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bkod/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ta a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can tu byas par gyur/ de nas dril bu glegs bam lag tu gtad la/ bu yi gzhan don bla med phyir// phrin las thog pa med par byos// khyod ni rdo rje slob dpon te// chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ro// bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tshe dpag med yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/

bdag nyid tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i khar zhugs par gyur/ sngags phreng bzung*/ oṃ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐= oṃ swā= oṃ oṃ= oṃ āḥ= oṃ bh+rūm̐= oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra= swa= oṃ= āḥ= oṃ bh+rūm̐= a pa ri= su bi ni swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di la stsal lags kyi/ 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum gyis me tog phreng ba spyi bor bzhag ste/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gtad/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can ma lus drangs bya'i phyir// chags pa med pa'i bsam pa yis// ji ltar gdul bya sna tshogs la// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// de bzhin phrin las gang 'dul ba// khyod kyi phrin las mchog yin no//

de bzhin thog mtha' mtshungs par 'khor lo'i tshab tu/ rdo rje'i= rin chen= pad+ma'i= ral gri'i zhes kha bsgyur bar bya/ dgang blugs gtad/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis// zhi dang rgyas dang bsad pa dang*// dgugs dang bcing dang bsreg pa dang*// bskrad dang dbye ba la sogs pa// phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub par bya'o// ral gri gtad/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lahwam de bzhin ril bu ste// mi snang bcud len mkha' la spyod// thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa// de dag khyod kyis bsgrub par gyis// mig thur gtad/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis sel/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ me long gzugs brnyan shar ba bstan/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// chos rnams de ltar shes par gyis// mda' gzhu gtad/ hoḥ zhes brjod/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i bsam pas phyogs bzhir 'phang bar bya'o// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// sogs lan gsum bya/ bum dbang ngo*// gsang dbang ni/ bla ma longs sku'i bdag nyid can la gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags ri bcas// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkang ste// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun 'bul na// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas bskyab tu gsol/ gu ru i dam maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ ces maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur thob// gsang ba'i dbang bskur dam pa yang*// de ring bdag la stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma bcom ldan 'das yab yum du gsal ba snyoms par zhugs pas/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar bha gar bab pa lces blang par gyur

par mos te/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// rdo rje 'dzin sogs dbang bskur bas// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro// zhes bdud rtsi byin/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes btung*/ des ngag gi dri ma dag gsang dbang thob/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ shes dbang dang*/ tshig dbang ni/ bla ma chos sku'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du dbang gsum pa zhu ba'i yon du/ ri rab gling bzhi sogs kyis phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyis bka' drin gyis// gsang ba'i dbang bskur dam pa thob// gong ma'i dbang bskur rnam gnyis kyang*/ de ring bdag la stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ bdag nyid tshe dpag med du gsal ba/ rig ma gos dkar mor gsal ba sangs rgyas thams cad dpang por byas te/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gtad par gyur/ rig tsaka bzung la/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che// bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma// blang nas bu yis dus kun tu// bla na med pa'i mchod par gyis// zhes gtad pa blangs/ de gnyis srub dang srub pa'i sbyor bas byang sems gsang ba'i sna rtser phab/ bde bas rnam par rtog pa thams cad nub par gyur pa'i skabs/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems ni cir yang grub pa med// gsal bzhag dgag sgrub bral bas na// 'di ni rang rig ye shes yin// zhes brda sprad/ de dag gis ni yid dang ye shes kyi dri ma dag dbang gong ma gnyis thob/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku dang ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ de nas bla mas chos gos kyi gra ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas la/ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// ngas 'dir khyod la lung bstan bya// srid pa ngan 'gro las bton pa// srid pa shin tu dag phyir ro// sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dh+ya sa ma ya s+t+wam̐/ bhur+bhu ba swa/ zhes lung bstan/ khams gsum kun gyi rgyal po che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal ba'i// grong khyer mchog tu gzhug pa yin//

zhes dbugs dbyung ngo*// deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// ces dga' ba bsgom/ de nas/ nam mkha'i dbyings rnams kun nas gang ba'i spos kyi chu gter 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin rgyas par khyab pa'i snying por nor bu'i 'khor yug gi /nang na zhing khams rgya mtsho sa gzhi rin chen las grub rim gyis gzhol ba bkod legs ma lus bkod pa'i phul gyis 'jig rten re'ang 'dod yon rmad byung 'phyur ba gang*// mtha' yas sangs rgyas zhing gis bskor zhing kun bzang mchod sprin ma tshang med pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i rdul rer rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa thams cad snang ba can// gcig tu 'du zhing so sor ma 'dres byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin de dag bdag gi dge ba'i sems kyis sprul te dpal ldan bla mar dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// zhing khams rgya mtsho rdul rer rdul rnyed kyi// sangs rgyas zhing dang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// kun gyis brgyan ldan ji snyed 'od 'phro'i rtser// rgyal ba sras bcas rnam thar kun snang zhing*// 'khor zhi'i 'dod dgu ma tshang med 'dus pa// chos dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'phrul// nam mkha'i khams khyab srid pa'i mthar gnas nas// chos kyi rgyal po mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya t+ya mi/ zhes gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul nas yon gyis bla ma mnyes par bya'o// 'di mtshams chos skyong spyi yi bskang gsol dang*/ khyad par bka' srung lha sman rgyal mo bkra shis tshe ring ma'i gsol mchod rgyas par bya/ tshogs rdzas bshams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ ma dag pa sbyangs/ āḥmang por spel/ hūm̐ bdud rtsi lnga dang sgrol ma lnga'i rang bzhin du sbar/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum/ spyan 'dren cing byin 'bebs pa ni/ gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla ma rin po che// dag pa'i zhing mchog gang la bzhugs lags kyang*// dad pa'i shugs kyis gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// thugs rje'i gter chen myur du 'byon du gsol// dam rdzas 'di rnams ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur// bdag cag rnams la byin rlabs dbang bskur nas// 'bral ba med par rjes su bzung mdzad cing*// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// bdag gis rtse gcig bsgrub pa'i yi dam lha// dag pa'i= dad pa'i= thugs rje'i= dam rdzas= bdag cag= 'bral ba= 'chi med= dam tshig can gyi stangs 'dzin mkha' 'gro ma// dag pa'i= dad pa'i= thugs rje'i= dam rdzas= bdag cag= 'bral ba= 'chi med= kun tu srung skyob byed pa'i chos skyong tshogs// dag pa'i= dad pa'i= thugs rje'i= dam rdzas= bdag cag= 'bral ba= 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// tshogs phud dang po/ dang po phud kyi mchod pa 'di// byin gyis rlobs pa'i bla ma dang*// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro ma// phrin las sgrub pa'i chos skyong la// dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas ma lus pa// nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te 'bul/ bar pa/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong thams cad rang sems su// gcig pa sngon chad ma 'tshal bas// bdag gis nyes pa thams cad byas// de ni so so rang rig pa'i// ye shes klong du mthol lags na// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag bzhin// dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// mtha' ma/ bdag gi tshe 'phrog gdon gyi tshogs// 'chi bdag bdud kyi sder bcas rnams// tshogs 'dir bstim nas khyed zhal btab// rtag tu bgegs dang phral bar shog/ gtor ma phul/ chos skyong spyi dang bka' srung tshe ring ma'i skong bshags bya/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs la las kyi rdo rjes me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/

bsod nams 'di yis sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes thob par gyur cig ces pas btung ba nas rim bzhin tshogs rnams drangs te lha dang nang gi sbyin sreg gi nges pas tshim pa'i bar la rol mo/ spro na rdo rje'i glu sogs len/ lhag ma rnams bsdus te kha phru la sogs btab pas bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis brlabs/ lhag la dgyes pa'i ma dang sring*// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phral can// dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra// dgyes par 'di la rol nas kyang*// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las// gang la gang 'os mdzad pas na// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub pa yi// dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā/ lhag ma phyir dor/ tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du// sogs kyi smon lam bya'o// slar dkyil 'khor la gtang rag gi mchod bstod bsdus pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dhu pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= rū pa= girti= ra s+ya= spar+she= dharma dhartu= bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dang*// rigs pa'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs la// bdag gis dad pas bstod par bgyi// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// yi ge brgya pa brjod pas bshags/ ma 'byor sogs bzod gsol dang*/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// sogs smon lam gdab/ dngos grub len pa ni/ dkyil 'khor la bskor te/ mos gdung dang bcas/ gang gis dran pa'i mod nyid la// 'chi bdag bdud ste 'joms gyur pa'i// tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor la// deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs// sgo gsum gus pas 'bangs su zhugs// rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub zhu// mi nub rgyal mtshan lta bu'i tshe// bdag gi lus la stsal du gsol// mi shig rdo rje lta bu'i tshe// bdag gi ngag=

mi shig g.yung drung= bdag gi yid= gsal rdzogs nyi zla= bdag gi nus mthur= bsam 'phel nor bu lta bu'i= bdag gi lus la= de nas/ rtsa yi zhing du rlung gi lam bstan te// khams kyi dwangs ma sems kyi sgrib sbyangs te// ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun gsal te// sku yi rdo rje thob par byin gyis rlobs// gsung gi rdo rje= thugs kyi= ye shes= zhes dngos grub zhus nas/ lha tshogs thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu/ bdag nyid la thim pas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur/ bdag bskyed bsdu rim ni/ bdag bskyed gzhal yas khang lha rnams dang*/ de rnams yum/ de gtso bo la rim bzhin thim/ mthar de yang mi dmigs pa stong nyid chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de las langs te dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas mthar dge bar bya'o// de ltar tshe dpag tu med pa'i nang sgrub kyi cho ga bsnyen sgrub dbang sogs legs par tshang ba sngags gra slob dpon ngag dbang kun dga' snying pos gsol pa btab pa'i ngor/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos byams pa chen po'i chos gling du mdzad pa nyid las/ da lam tshe chog nyin re la sogs stabs bder 'don pa'i 'grigs rnams blo dman rnams kyi don du shin tu gsal bar nag 'gros 'don chog nyid du/ ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis bris pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan rnams 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang dam pa thob par gyur cig /// /
